title: Using a custom statistical test
text: Let’s take first snarl info make test table combining phenotype. table used test, example fitting regression model. STOAT, also preprocess bit remove constant variables, obvious colinearity. sample column also used regression. ’ve created function mimick table preparation used STOAT. Now table contains: phenotype variable one several allele variables prefixed al one several covariables prefixed covar STOAT, fit model test coefficients allele variables different 0.
code: df = combine_chunk_phenotype_covars(chunk.l[[1]]$GT, pheno, covars)  df |> head() |> kable() df = preprocess_test_table(df)  df |> head() |> kable()

title: Using a custom statistical test
text: example, let’s compute pvalue fitting linear regression model snarl.
code: pv.df = lapply(chunk.l, function(snarl_info) {   ## combine allele count with the phenotype   df = combine_chunk_phenotype_covars(snarl_info$GT, pheno, covars)   df = preprocess_test_table(df)    ## run the regression   model = lm(phenotype ~ ., data=df)   ## null hypothesis is all allele coeffs are 0   null.h = paste0(grep('^al', colnames(df), value=TRUE), '=0')   lh.o = linearHypothesis(model, null.h)   pv = lh.o[['Pr(>F)']][2]    ## return a data.frame with the snarl information and the test result   return(tibble(START_NODE=snarl_info$START_NODE, END_NODE=snarl_info$END_NODE,                 P=pv)) }) |> bind_rows()  pv.df |> head() |> kable()
